business_scope.primary_industry_name: Multi-Parameter Bedside Telemetry Monitor Assembly and Calibration

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Business Companies Act, Chapter 270 (Revised Edition 2020), as amended; Money Laundering and Terrorism (Prevention) Act, Chapter 104; Financial Intelligence Unit Act, Chapter 104A; Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Regulations and the Belize Central Register of Beneficial Ownership established under the Companies (Amendment) Act, 2018.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport of each proposed director/shareholder/UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or competent authority in country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (e.g., utility bill or bank statement not older than 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider, bank, or government body in country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming professional/business relationship and source of funds
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (if from non-Hague APC member) or Hague Apostille

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation and good standing of any corporate shareholder (if any)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry in jurisdiction of incorporation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Curriculum vitae or professional reference letter for the proposed director/UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Current employer or professional body in the country of origin

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all proposed directors, shareholders, and UBOs against the Belize Financial Intelligence Unit list, OFAC SDN List, HM Treasury Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, EU Consolidated Sanctions List, UN Security Council Sanctions (Chapter VII), and CARICOM targeted financial sanctions. Full name, date of birth, nationality, and address matching required. Negative news and adverse media index review required. For PEPs, enhanced due diligence must be approved by the company's Anti-Money Laundering Compliance Officer, including source of wealth and source of funds verification.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (CBCAR) - Electronically searchable and reserveable through the official online portal administered by the Ministry of Commerce, Economic Development and Investment
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The proposed name must be in English or Roman script; non-Latin scripts must be transliterated into English using the official transliteration scheme. The name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered company or reserved name. Suffixes permitted for IBCs: Limited, Ltd., Corporation, Corp., Incorporated, Inc., Société Anonyme (S.A.), Sociedad Anónima (S.A.), and similar equivalents. The name must be distinct in Belize and not imply an undertaking legally unattended in Belize.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the name application is rejected or flagged for administrative reasons, the proposed incorporator may submit a written administrative appeal to the Registrar of the Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry within 21 days of rejection, specifying grounds and requesting ministerial approval for any sensitive token. If the Registrar maintains the rejection, the appellant may file a judicial review application to the Belize Supreme Court (High Court) pursuant to the Companies Act and the Supreme Court of Judicature Act. No extension of the 30-day reservation period is automatic; a fresh reservation application may be filed upon expiry.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office services are permissible for mail forwarding, telephone answering, and administrative support, but the IBC must maintain a physical registered office address in Belize staffed by a licensed registered agent. The registered agent must be a licensed attorney-at-law, trust company, or accredited management firm. A purely virtual address without physical presence of the registered agent is not permitted.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (estimated 5% probability per year for a standard low-risk, non-regulated electronics trading company). The Belize Financial Intelligence Unit and the Registrar may perform unannounced physical inspections where AML/CFT risk flags arise, but for ISIC 3250 (patient monitoring hardware) without local operational presence, the regulatory inspection priority is classified as low.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Business Companies Act, Chapter 270 of the Laws of Belize (Revised Edition 2020), ss. 3, 4, 6, 21, 27, 36 and 92; Companies (Amendment) Act 2022 where applicable.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Companies Registry, International Business Companies Section, Ministry of Finance, Belmopan, Belize; filing through a licensed IBC registered agent.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IBC-1 Application for Incorporation of an International Business Company together with the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; authorised capital is stated in the Memorandum and may be as low as one share of no par value; no escrow account or capitalization deposit is required for a Belize IBC.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscribers to the Memorandum and Articles of Association hereby adopt the Articles of the Belize International Business Company and confirm subscription to the issued share capital as stated in the register of members. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Company shall continue at the address of the appointed Belize registered agent, or as subsequently filed at the Companies Registry. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the initial directors and officers named on the register be and are hereby appointed, with full authority to open bank accounts, appoint service providers, and execute documents in the Company’s name. UNANIMOUSLY PASSED.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Clearance and Appointment of Licensed Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies Registry IBC Section, Belmopan; through a licensed Belize IBC registered agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a registered agent licensed under the International Business Companies Act; instruct the agent to perform a name availability search; submit the proposed corporate name and corporate purpose for preliminary clearance; ensure the name does not conflict with existing Belize entities and includes a restricted suffix such as Limited, Corporation, or Inc.
required_dossiers: Identity and residential proof of proposed subscribers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused or confusingly similar, resubmit an amended name reservation within three business days; the Registrar permits substitution without loss of priority if no competing application has been accepted.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed IBC registered agent and Belize attorney-at-law.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Memorandum and Articles of Association; insert authorized share capital, share classes, objects, registered office clause, and first director provisions; have each subscriber execute the documents before a notary public or equivalent officer; obtain the first director’s written consent to act.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry raises a formalities deficiency in execution or notarization, correct the affected signature block, re-notarize, and file a document requisition response within 14 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of IBC-1 Application and Payment of Government Filing Fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies Registry IBC Section, Belmopan; online portal or authorized registered agent submission.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Form IBC-1 together with the executed Memorandum and Articles, registered agent consent, and paid government filing fee; remit the fee by bank wire or registered agent trust account; obtain an official stamped receipt and applicant reference number.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association in duplicate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried for incompleteness, file a written objection or cure notice within 30 days furnishing the missing schedules; resubmission after cure is processed without re-payment if the original fee receipt remains valid.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Receipt of Certificate of Incorporation and Company Registration Particulars
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon registry approval, collect or receive the Certificate of Incorporation with the IBC company number; verify the registered office and registered agent details shown on the certificate; update the statutory register with incorporation date, company number, and initial capital.
required_dossiers: Notice of registered office and registered agent
Initial register of members and directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate contains clerical errors, submit a written correction request with the original certificate for reissuance; the Registry typically issues a corrected certificate within five business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adoption of First Board Resolution and Issuance of Shares
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: First directors acting at the registered office of the IBC in Belize.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 days of incorporation, convene the statutory first board meeting; pass the first board resolution adopting the share subscription and registered office appointment; appoint officers; approve issuance of share certificates; record the resolutions in the minute book.
required_dossiers: Share certificates and register of members
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the minutes or resolution contain a procedural defect, the directors may ratify all actions by an unanimously signed subsequent board resolution; no filing fee is required for internal ratification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Compliance and Annual License Renewal Preparation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies Registry IBC Section; Belize Ministry of Finance for annual fee collection.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Verify annual government license/renewal fee obligations through the registered agent; maintain registered office and direction information; update the registry if shares are allotted or directors change; file any required notice of change and pay the annual IBC renewal fee before the statutory deadline.
required_dossiers: Updated notices of director or share allotment if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If annual renewal is late, pay the prescribed penalty within the Registrar’s late renewal grace period; if inadvertently struck off, apply for reinstatement under the reinstatement procedure with payment of arrears and penalties.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Belize Bureau of Standards, Ministry of Economic Development, in coordination with the Ministry of Health and Wellness for medical device manufacturing.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Medical Device Establishment License for Manufacturing, Assembly and Calibration under the Belize Standards (Quality Control) Act and applicable Medical Devices Regulations.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of the Environment, Ministry of Sustainable Development, Climate Change and Disaster Risk Management, Belize
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 2 – Environmental Compliance Plan / Registration; not a full EIA Report for low-impact electronics assembly and calibration operations, subject to DOE confirming lower risk classification.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater discharge into water bodies or land; sanitary effluent shall comply with DOE discharge limits including BOD5 not exceeding 30 mg/L and pH 6–9 where treated and discharged; soldering and calibration processes must control VOCs and solder fumes using local extract ventilation to maintain workplace airborne VOC concentrations within Belize occupational exposure limits; e-waste and spent solder shall be segregated as hazardous waste and disposed through a licensed waste carrier under the Environment Protection Act.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: National Fire Service Certificate of Life Safety and Fire Prevention for the assembly and calibration facility; Building Inspectorate structural load and occupancy certificate for the calibration laboratory; Ministry of Labour workplace registration and occupational safety clearance; Ministry of Health sanitation approval for the premises used in medical device assembly.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Belize Tax Service (Ministry of Finance) – official portal: https://www.belizetaxservice.gov.bz
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity establishing a fixed establishment or other taxable presence in Belize must apply for a Tax Identification Number (TIN) with the Belize Tax Service using the prescribed registration form, supported by certified copies of the entity's formation documents, registered office certificate, evidence of local address, and appointment of a local tax agent. For an International Business Company (IBC), the entity is statutorily exempt from Belize income tax, business tax, stamp duty and capital gains tax; the IBC may obtain a Certificate of Exemption from its registered agent or the Belize Companies Registry under the International Business Companies Act. A foreign entity that makes taxable supplies in Belize and meets the GST threshold must additionally register for GST and obtain a VAT/GST ID number from the Belize Tax Service, filing a separate GST registration application.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: An IBC may elect under the International Business Companies Act to be treated as a Belize domestic company, thereby losing its tax-exempt status and becoming subject to ordinary Belize income tax at the applicable corporate rates; this election is irrevocable and requires filing of an election notice with the Companies Registry. Belize does not operate a US-style check-the-box regime, and no hybrid mismatch elections are currently available. Certain cross‑border arrangements may be challenged under Belize's participation in the OECD Base Erosion and Profit Shifting framework, requiring self-assessment and filing of additional returns where applicable.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: BZD $150,000 (Belize dollars) in annual taxable supplies; registration is mandatory for every person (including a foreign entity with a fixed establishment in Belize) who carries on a taxable activity and has taxable supplies exceeding this threshold. Foreign entities may voluntarily register if they make taxable supplies and wish to claim input credits.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Belize does not currently mandate a real-time electronic invoicing or fiscal-clearance digital stamping system. Registered taxpayers must issue serially numbered tax invoices in an approved electronic or paper format, retain a valid GST registration number on invoices, and file monthly GST returns and payments via the Belize Tax Service online e-file portal. Although electronic filing is required for registered taxpayers, there is no continuous API-based clearance or pre-approval of invoices by the tax authority.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exportation of tangible goods from Belize, including multi-parameter electronic patient monitors, is zero-rated under section 44 of the General Sales Tax Act when the exporter is registered for GST and the goods are physically removed from Belize within a reasonable period. Also zero-rated are services physically performed offshore, and services directly related to goods exported from Belize, provided the services are supplied to an international recipient, paid in foreign currency, and not used in Belize. The supplier must obtain and retain documentary evidence of export.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Airway Bill
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank transfer evidence of foreign currency payment
GST Export Schedule and zero-rating supporting worksheet
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Belize Tax Service may audit any zero-rated export transaction and require production of the complete export documentation bundle within a stated period. If the export is false, unsupported, or the goods are found to have remained in or returned to Belize, the taxpayer must repay the zero-rated GST together with interest at 15% per annum and penalties of up to 100% of the tax under the General Sales Tax Act. Where export proceeds are not repatriated within 180 days, the Central Bank of Belize foreign exchange regulations may be engaged, leading to administrative fines, loss of export status and judicial enforcement; deliberate fraud may also result in criminal prosecution.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Belize (CBB), operating under the Central Bank of Belize Act, Chapter 262 and the Exchange Control Act, Chapter 58 of the Laws of Belize; the CBB serves as the sole monetary, foreign exchange, and financial stability authority, with delegated exchange control powers administered through authorized dealers (licensed domestic commercial banks).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Belize dollar (BZD) is pegged to the US dollar (USD) at a fixed rate of BZD 2.00 per USD 1.00 under the Currency Act; the current account (trade goods, services, dividends, interest) is freely convertible for authorized dealer transactions, while capital account movements remain subject to CBB exchange control approval under the Exchange Control Act. Belize International Business Companies (IBCs) are statutorily designated as non-resident entities for exchange control purposes: their operations must be transacted in a foreign currency, and they are exempt from convertibility restrictions, CBB prior approval, and surrender obligations on foreign-held funds; profit remittance by an IBC to foreign shareholders is permitted without CBB licensing provided the dividend payment is made from an external (offshore) foreign-currency account, whereas conversion into BZD or onshore settlement with a Belize resident would trigger exchange control scrutiny.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For resident exporters under the Exchange Control Act, foreign currency export proceeds must be repatriated to Belize within six months from the date of export and, upon receipt, must be offered for sale to an authorized dealer in exchange for BZD within one month absent an approved retention facility or designated foreign-currency account. Non-resident IBCs, including the target entity under the International Business Companies Act, are expressly exempt from repatriation and mandatory surrender ratios and may retain 100% of export proceeds in free foreign-currency accounts held with a licensed Belize bank or licensed foreign bank.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.economic_substance_note: Under the Economic Substance Act 2019 and the International Business Companies (Amendment) Act 2022, an IBC carrying on a 'distribution and service centre' activity must demonstrate core income-generating activities, board management and control in Belize, and adequate physical presence; a tax-exempt IBC holding a Certificate of Tax Exemption is permitted, but the treasury plan must avoid any indicia of a shell arrangement that could trigger an economic substance penalty, CBB bank review, or removal of the IBC's tax exemption.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (USD multicurrency current account with SWIFT facility)
Capital Escrow Account (USD non-resident IBC account for inward share subscription)
Capital Escrow Account and Trade Settlement Account (USD with Commercial LC desk)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low Feasibility: Belize has no statutory digital banking, electronic money institution (EMI), or payment-service-issuer licensing regime distinct from the Banking Act; non-bank fintech providers cannot lawfully hold client funds or issue payment instruments in Belize without a Banking and Financial Institutions Act license or a Money Services Business license under the FSC supervision framework. Offshore EMIs (e.g., Revolut Business, Wise Business, Airwallex) do not hold Belize licenses, would be deemed unauthorized deposit takers if they onboard a Belize IBC with onshore settlement, and local authorized dealers are prohibited from routing corporate payments through unlicensed third-party payment aggregators; cross-border EMI rails may only be used by the IBC as a treasury visibility tool outside Belize, subject to strict prohibition against receiving trade receivables or paying trade payables from Belize-located operations.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is mandatory: the CBB AML/CFT Directive and each bank's internal CDD policy require at least one director and the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) to attend an in-person due diligence interview at the Belize branch; no fully remote account opening is permitted for a non-resident IBC unless the account is introduced by a licensed international financial services provider or registered agent holding an introducer certificate from the Belize Financial Services Commission (FSC), in which case remote e-signatures may be accepted only after the introducer attests to sighting original identity documents and the bank performs a video verification overlay. In practice the target entity should physically appear in Belize City for the initial bank meeting, accompanied by the registered agent, and must present original passports, board resolutions, certificate of incorporation, certificate of good standing, and signed natural-person UBO declarations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Red Flag: Cross-border medical-device distribution to distributors in Latin America and the Caribbean generating high-volume incoming wire transfers with inconsistent invoice patterns (trade-based money laundering suspicion).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Production-quality compliance file comprising ISO 13485 certificate, EU MDR or CE technical documentation, FDA establishment registration and device listing, master distribution agreements with named counterparty due-diligence on each distributor, proforma invoices matching exact unit sale prices, packing lists, bills of lading and air waybills, customs declarations, quality certificates per shipment, and quarterly reports summarizing end-customer hospital purchase orders.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Red Flag: IBC perceived as a shell entity with no tangible presence, no employees in Belize, and manager-controlled governance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Lease agreement for registered office and physical meeting room in Belize City, minutes of board meetings physically held in Belize evidencing strategic control, employment or engagement contracts with a Belize-based corporate service provider and local compliance officer, Economic Substance filing acknowledgement from the Belize FSC, utility bills in the IBC's name, and a capital-expenditure plan showing calibration equipment or contract manufacturing tooling addressed to the Belize registered office.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Red Flag: Discrepancy between stated gross revenue and banking transaction profile, especially rapid round-tripping of funds between the operational account and shareholder affiliates.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Intercompany back-to-back purchase orders from the contract manufacturer, original supplier invoices with unique serial numbers, bank statements for the IBC's home-country operational subsidiary, audited financial statements covering two fiscal years, and a written explanation of the working-capital cycle including inventory turnover days and receivable aging report.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Red Flag: Sanctions and PEP exposure of non-resident directors or UBOs domiciled in high-risk jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed declaration of source of wealth, certified passport copies, independent background check report from a recognized screening provider, professional reference letter from a regulated attorney or accountant in the director's home jurisdiction, proof of physical residency, and confirmation that no party is subject to OFAC/EU/UN sanctions or politically exposed person status.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound routing for the initial equity contribution: the shareholder executes a board resolution of the IBC approving USD 100,000 share capital subscription; funds are wired via SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's bank to the IBC's USD capital escrow account at Atlantic Bank Limited with the beneficiary field naming the IBC and the payment reference 'BZ IBC share capital subscription - [entity ID]'; the remitter must include the CBB 13-digit corporate reference code and complete an inward remittance declaration for balance-of-payments statistical purposes; the IBC's registered agent files form INC-2/IBC annual return noting the issuance of shares; the receiving bank will require the share subscription agreement, certificate of incorporation, and UBO declaration prior to crediting; funds must remain in the escrow account for a minimum of five business days to satisfy the bank's internal fraud-control verification window, after which they are transferred to the operational account via internal journal entry.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade disbursements to the contract manufacturer and component suppliers settle through two primary rails: (1) SWIFT MT103 for open-account payments, supplier deposits, and engineering NRE charges, using the IBC's USD account at Belize Bank Limited with a correspondent bank (e.g., Citibank or Bank of America USD clearing account) and the payment reference populated with the purchase order number, clause of Incoterms 2020, and commercial invoice numbering; (2) Documentary Commercial Letter of Credit issued by Belize Bank Limited under UCP600 (ICC Publication 600) via SWIFT MT700 to the supplier's confirming bank, with MT707 amendments for partial shipments; sight drafts on the Belize bank's USD nostro account ensure the supplier's bank receives a clean MUREX MT202 cover payment; all shipments require a full set of clean-on-board bills of lading, commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin (preferably from the manufacturing jurisdiction), and ISO 13485 certificate of conformance; for inward letters of credit received from LATAM distributors, the IBC must present documents through Belize Bank's trade finance desk with negotiation at sight and discounting of the LC proceeds at the CBB's preserved spread over LIBOR/SOFR.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Short-dated deliverable forwards in BZD/USD with a licensed authorized dealer (Belize Bank or Atlantic Bank) for administrative expense conversion only, maximum tenor 3 months, non-speculative, fully trade-backed

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing BZD/USD executed with an offshore international bank (e.g., a London or New York prime broker) where the Belize IBC is the non-resident counterparty and the notional does not exceed the value of outstanding BZD-denominated local operating costs

Cross-currency swaps (BZD vs USD) between the IBC and an authorized dealer for the sole purpose of hedging a discrete capital commitment or acquisition liability, subject to CBB prior notification via the dealer and a cap of USD 250,000 notional

Natural hedge treasury policy: all trade receivables, trade payables, and intercompany balances are denominated exclusively in USD to eliminate transactional FX exposure; the IBC is prohibited from holding any open BZD position beyond a maximum overnight net exposure of BZD 20,000

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government License Fee / Retention Fee (paid to maintain IBC good standing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (International Business Companies Registry)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the 31st day of May each year for companies incorporated between 1 January and 31 May; on or before the 30th day of November each year for companies incorporated between 1 June and 31 December; other IBCs pay within 90 days after the last day of the incorporation anniversary month.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment attracts a penalty of 10% of the annual fee for the first month or part thereof, plus 1% per additional month or part thereof, capped at 100% of the annual fee; continued non-payment after 90 days from the prescribed date may lead to administrative strike-off and dissolution, followed by a restoration fee plus all arrears and penalties.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory independent audit for Belize IBCs under the IBC Act; an audit may be required only by a resolution of the board or shareholders, by the Articles, or by a regulated activity license requiring audited financial statements (e.g., banking, insurance).
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS / Local GAAP as elected by the company; no statutory accounts need be filed with the Registry. Financial statements must be prepared and kept available for analysis if shareholders or creditors so require.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: IBC Act (as amended) requires a Beneficial Ownership Register to be kept at the registered office; any change in beneficial ownership (shareholding transfers exceeding qualifying thresholds) must be recorded and filed with the Registry within 14 days of the change. There is no separate 'annual UBO confirmation' return, but the company must ensure the registered UBO particulars are current as at each annual renewal date and any transfer/disposal is promptly notified.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 – USD 4,500 (only if voluntarily commissioned; not otherwise required)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for non-resident IBC statutory exemption; 8% concessionary IBC rate on Belize-source income; standard Belize domestic CIT headline rate is 25%.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Non-resident IBCs enjoy a statutory exemption on foreign-source income, yielding 0% effective tax. Approved export-oriented medical device manufacturers may obtain a 100% profit tax holiday for up to 15 years under the Fiscal Incentives Act. No preferential deduction is available for deemed IP costs unless economic substance tests are satisfied.
